newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya says Rwanda asked for its mediation.
newsitem.headline: Libya says Rwanda asked for its mediation.

text.p: Libya has accepted a request from the Rwandan government to help mediate in the conflict in the Great Lakes region, the official Libyan news agency JANA reported on Tuesday.
It said Rwanda's President Pasteur Bizimungu made the request in a letter to Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi delivered by Rwanda's envoy in Tripoli.
"Libya has accepted the request," JANA said in a report received in Tunis.
The Libyan foreign ministry will start contacts with all parties in the conflict and with African states to find a peaceful solution, it added.
There was no immediate confirmation from the Rwandan government that such a request had been made to Libya, which is under partial economic sanctions imposed by the United Nations.
